protocol.decision_rule: Per-lot diagnostics only: weekly full turnover, no NAV, no participation/capacity. A positive result is INCONCLUSIVE until the R7 portfolio regression passes. Floors unmet => BLOCKED. All trials retained.
protocol.floor_application: Ranking lane is governed by the date floors (>=120 train dates, >=40 test dates per fold). The 50 events/class floor applies only to classification targets (MR lane, unchanged from v1); stock rows within a date are not independent events and are never counted toward any floor.

activity.applies_to: monthly portfolio activity; reported separately from add-ons; never forced

folds.note: 121 first train dates so >=120 remain after the one-date purge; folds = as many full 40-date test blocks as fit
folds.scheme: expanding date folds, fixed geometry, purge by label_available_at

protocol.independence_rule: Decision dates are every 5th session of the VNINDEX calendar from 2022-09-01 (index 0,5,10,...). Entry = next open, exit = close of entry+5 sessions, so consecutive lot return windows do not overlap (exit close t+6 precedes the next entry only at the same session's open). A date counts as independent only on that rule; overlapping or daily dates never count toward floors.

inference.correction: Bonferroni over the 2 primary comparisons; ablations and controls are descriptive only; unknown past trials not corrected
inference.method: paired circular block bootstrap on date-level (top10 - universe) net return
